name: Long Distance Relationship
source:
Long Distance Relationship is a game about a couple that decided to keep their relationship as Mary, MC's girlfriend, decided to move abroad for an exchange program! How will they keep their relationship fling alive during this adventure?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/longdistancerelationshipgame/about]Patreon[/url]]
